preprocess_filter.responsibility: Filter ultra-sparse cells (FB2 guard), normalize library size (FB4 guard), select HVGs, PCA -> adata.obsm['X_pca']. Sets adata.obs['impute_confidence']=0 for sub-threshold cells so they are kept out of downstream graph construction.

build_cell_graph.responsibility: Build the row-normalized kNN cell-similarity graph W (cosine on X_pca) and the symmetric normalized Laplacian L = I - (W+W^T)/2. Stores W -> adata.obsp['connectivities'], L -> adata.obsp['laplacian'].

graph_lowpass_basis.responsibility: Truncated Lanczos eigendecomposition of L for the k lowest-frequency eigenvectors U[:, :k] (the graph low-pass subspace). Bottleneck step; O(k*n_cells*n_neighbors).

fit_dispersion.responsibility: Per-gene NB dispersion phi[g] fit on observed nonzero entries with library-size offset, by method-of-moments.

em_impute_loop.responsibility: Generalized EM with LATENT mask M (marginalized, not observed). Mask-E-step computes soft responsibilities r[c,g]=P(M=0|X,Y,alpha,beta); Y-M-step solves smoothness-regularized expected-NB-MLE for Y with Y[:,masked] in span(U[:,:k]) (damped Newton, trust region -- NB log-lik only locally concave); Dropout-M-step Newton on logistic dropout (alpha, beta). Monotone ascent on the mask-marginalized Q; stop at relative change < 1e-4 or 50 iters.

diagnose_mnar.responsibility: Read beta_dropout_hat + CI from em_impute_loop; set adata.uns['mnar_flag'] / adata.uns['impute_confidence'] per FB1 guard. The MNAR self-diagnostic -- the novelty axis.

gene_bandwidth_diagnostic.responsibility: Per-gene graph-frequency spectrum: compute energy of each gene's observed signal in the high-graph-frequency bands (above cutoff); widen k or fall back to NB-mean for genes whose energy is concentrated high (FB3 guard).

acceptance_criteria.statement: WHEN the DGP runs the MNAR sweep with beta in {-1.0, -2.0} THE SYSTEM SHALL set adata.uns['mnar_flag']=True for the strong-MNAR regime (beta=-2.0) and report adata.uns['beta_dropout'] within +/-0.2 of the ground-truth beta. Pass line: |beta_dropout_hat - beta_true| < 0.2 for >=4 of 5 seeds at beta_true=-2.0; mnar_flag==True for all 5 seeds.
WHEN the DGP runs the MAR/null regime (beta=0) THE SYSTEM SHALL set adata.uns['mnar_flag']=False (correctly NOT flag MAR as MNAR). Pass line: mnar_flag==False for >=4 of 5 seeds at beta_true=0.

IF mnar_flag==True THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL document in adata.uns['mnar_disclaimer'] that the masked-entry counts are NOT identifiable without an external instrument (spike-ins / paired full-length), and impute_confidence SHALL be scaled by 1/(1+|beta_dropout_hat|). This is a known-limitation disclosure, NOT a 'pass' -- the method cannot make MNAR-recovered counts identifiable.

WHEN a cell has fewer than min_genes (default 500) genes detected THE SYSTEM SHALL set adata.obs['impute_confidence']=0 for that cell and exclude it from neighborhood-graph construction. Verified by an automated unit test: construct an AnnData with one sub-threshold cell and assert it is flagged + held out.

WHEN the DGP sweeps n_detected_genes in {100, 500, 2000} THE SYSTEM SHALL report recovery RMSE split by regime, and the n_detected=2000 regime RMSE SHALL be lower than n_detected=100 by >=30%. Pass line: median RMSE(2000) < 0.7 * median RMSE(100) across 5 seeds.

WHEN a gene's observed signal has >50% of its graph-frequency energy in the top half of the spectrum THE SYSTEM SHALL flag it via adata.var['high_freq_gene']=True and report adata.var['graph_bandwidth']. Verified by an automated unit test on a synthetic block-low-frequency + block-high-frequency signal.

WHEN library sizes differ across cells by >5x THE SYSTEM SHALL build the kNN graph on PCA of the depth-normalized matrix (NOT raw X) and SHALL include library size as an NB offset. Verified by an automated unit test: construct two depth-confounded batches; assert adata.obsp['connectivities'] is built from adata.obsm['X_pca'] (normalized), not adata.X (raw).

The NB mean SHALL be lib[c] * q[c,g] (library size as offset), so depth differences are NOT absorbed as biological signal. Justified analytically by inspecting the NB log-likelihood in em_impute_loop: the lib offset decouples depth from the rate parameter q.

WHEN evaluated on the mask-then-impute benchmark with an expression-INDEPENDENT Bernoulli(p=0.2) mask THE SYSTEM SHALL achieve held-out-count RMSE strictly lower than ALL four naive baselines (all-zero, global-mean, per-gene-mean, kNN-mean) AND no worse than the weakest SOTA imputer (MAGIC), under matched compute and 5 seeds. Leakage check: |coef| of mask-indicator ~ log-expression < 0.05.

WHEN evaluated in the null regime (true zeros injected) THE SYSTEM SHALL report a false-imputation rate (fraction of true-zero positions filled with nonzero counts) no higher than the per-gene-mean baseline. The method must not hallucinate counts where the truth is zero.

WHEN n_cells >= 10000 THE SYSTEM SHALL use truncated Lanczos eigendecomposition (scipy.sparse.linalg.eigsh, k=64, which='SM') NOT full eigendecomposition, and SHALL complete the full impute pipeline on n_cells=10000, n_genes=2000 in <30 min wall-clock on a single CPU core with <16 GB RAM. Verified by a scalability smoke test.
